top_signals.title: How the French language contributed to the U.S.-Canada trade war
top_signals.summary: The dispute with the U.S. was not just about tariff demands but what Canada's prime minister called unacceptable "threats" to the French language and "Quebec culture."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
